title: Split Foundation attempt admission from server launch-template completion
description: PREREQUISITE carved from task-fc9660b0 after comment-1556fa6 measured a causal cycle. The current service decodes a 5-key request containing launchTemplate and hashes it before prepareCapture, while the real producer now requires renderedContext whose durable read depends on the capture created only later. Introduce the smallest internal two-phase protocol: admit/reserve/prepare capture and seal context from a request carrying no launchTemplate, then invoke a REQUIRED server-owned launch-template completion authority and continue the existing launch/settle path. The completion authority is a dependency, never payload data; it receives the producer template from the real context-seal result plus the committed assignment/identities needed by the consumer. This row is the dependency leaf; consumer task-fc9660b0 will compose runtime/credential/cwd authorities and retire the transport key after this lands.
